spans.s:
दुवन्य दुवन्य (perhaps fr. rt. 1. दु), Ved.
worshipping.
—दुवन्य-सद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. (Sāy.)
dwelling among worshippers, abiding with the de-
vout; [cf. दुवस् below.]

दुवस्, अस्, n., Ved. worship, honour, reverence;
(Sāy.) wealth; (आस्, आस्, अस्), active, moving rest-
lessly.
—दुवस्-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते,
-कर्तुम्, to worship.
—दुवस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved.
worshipping; enjoying or receiving worship.
—दु-
वो-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to
worship.

दुवसन, अस्, आ, अम्, active, moving; (Sāy.)
adorable, worthy of worship.

2. दुवस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (according to Sāy.)
worthy of worship or honour.

दुवस्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. honouring, worshipping,
respectful.

दुवोया, f., Ved. worship; (only occurring in inst.
दुवोया, in worship.)

दुवोयु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. honouring, worshipping;
(उ), ind. reverently; out of acknowledgment.
